beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and aspiring administrators who are new to MariaDB. Covers installation, how MariaDB differs from MySQL, storage engines, data types, constraints and sql_mode, querying, joins, window functions and CTEs, RETURNING and upserts, sequences, indexes, transactions, users and roles, stored code, views and events, JSON, bulk loading, connectors and logical backups, finishing with an online shop database.
prerequisites: Knows what a database table and a row are, or has used a spreadsheet with formulas
Uses a terminal to run commands and edit text files
Has a Linux, macOS or Windows machine with Docker or permission to install MariaDB Server
outcomes: Install MariaDB, connect securely and explain how it differs from MySQL
Write correct queries using joins, window functions, CTEs, RETURNING and sequences
Protect data with constraints, transactions, roles and tested logical backups
Build, load, secure and back up a complete shop database from an application
